editorial:
Imagine spending a sunny summer at a quiet country estate where everything seems perfect, but there is a lot of hidden tension under the surface. You get to follow a woman who feels like her life is becoming a bit boring as she hits middle age. She has a husband who is fine, but she finds herself drawn to the handsome young tutor she hired for her ward. It is a slow-burn story about longing and secret crushes, giving you that cozy, old-world feeling where a simple look or a short walk in the garden feels like a huge deal.

The acting is great and really captures that awkward feeling of falling for someone you know you should not. While the pace is a bit slow for people who like action, it works well for a romantic drama. If you enjoy stories about forbidden love and beautiful scenery, you will love this. Since it is an older TV movie, your best bet is to look for a high-quality digital copy to rent on Apple TV or see if you can find a restored version on a physical disc to add to your collection for a crisp picture.
endingExplained: After a summer of flirting and deep emotional connection, the romance does not end with a fairytale wedding. The tutor eventually leaves the estate, leaving the woman to deal with the sadness of her lost love. You see her realize that her feelings were a beautiful dream that could not last in the real world. She goes back to her normal life, forever changed by the brief spark of passion she felt.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic romance stories and quiet dramas.
